# Workstation Comparison Matrix

| Attribute     | Aurora 14                  | Summit X15                 | Vantage Pro 16             |
|---------------|----------------------------|----------------------------|----------------------------|
| CPU           | Helix H9 AI, 16 cores      | Helix H7 AI, 12 cores      | Corvex X12, 14 cores       |
| GPU           | Vireo V8000 Pro, 16 GB     | Vireo V6000, 8 GB          | Vireo V9000, 24 GB         |
| Max Memory    | 128 GB (user-upgradeable)  | 96 GB                      | 64 GB (soldered)           |
| Max Storage   | 4 TB NVMe                  | not stated                 | 2 TB                       |
| Display       | 14-inch OLED, 2880x1800, 120 Hz | 15.6-inch OLED, 3840x2400, 60 Hz | 16-inch IPS, 2560x1600, 165 Hz |
| Weight        | 1.65 kg                    | 1.95 kg                    | 2.30 kg                    |
| Battery       | 86 Wh                      | not stated                 | 99 Wh                      |
| Ports         | 2x Thunderbolt 5, USB-A, HDMI 2.1, SD card reader | 2x Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, HDMI 2.1 | not stated                 |

## Aurora 14 Differentiators

1. **Highest memory expandability**: Supports up to 128 GB and is user-upgradeable, whereas the Summit X15 caps at 96 GB and the Vantage Pro 16 is limited to 64 GB soldered memory.

2. **Lightest chassis at 1.65 kg**: Weighs less than both competitors (Summit X15: 1.95 kg; Vantage Pro 16: 2.30 kg), making it the most portable option.

3. **Fastest connectivity with Thunderbolt 5**: Equipped with two Thunderbolt 5 ports, while the Summit X15 offers only Thunderbolt 4, and the Vantage Pro 16 does not state its port configuration.
